newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank sees weaker 97 domestic lending.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank sees weaker 97 domestic lending.

text.p: Commerzbank AG chief executive Martin Kohlhaussen said on Tuesday he expected domestic lending business to weaken in 1997.
"We will be operating in a difficult environment with a recognisably recessive development," he told reporters. "We cannot expect the lending growth we've had in previous years."
Kohlhaussen said Commerzbank would be looking for growth in off balance sheet business this year and would also focus on foreign expansion, particularly in South East Asia and America.
He said he was "quite hopeful" of improving the bank's trading result, but he cautioned: "trading depends on markets and often on luck".
Referring to the sharp rise in risk provisions in 1996, Kohlhaussen said this was not a sign of poor asset quality.
"On the contrary, this reflects the good quality of our operating earnings, it's not necessarily anything to do with bad asset quality."
